title: Editor E4 remainder: put the canvas on the live channel and build the RSC parity harness
detail: Split from PROG-E4B on 2026-11-10. /pages/canvas edits a page-local Y.Doc. Still owed: the canvas joins lib/editor-crdt/provider for a real entity so two browsers converge on one page, and the RSC-canvas parity harness. Dark.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const d="components/builder/canvas";const ok=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>/\.tsx$/.test(f)&&!/\.test\./.test(f)).some(f=>/editor-crdt\/provider/.test(fs.readFileSync(d+"/"+f,"utf8")));if(!ok){console.error("PROG-E4C: no canvas component joins the live channel (lib/editor-crdt/provider)");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main: the canvas uses a page-local doc. Passes once a canvas component connects through lib/editor-crdt/provider.
